title: Consensus design and in silico screening of GH42 beta-galactosidase for enhanced catalytic hydrolysis of whey lactose.
authors: Ding, Simeng; Li, Jiajia; Li, Jiahui; Nie, Huayu; Li, Yongxin; Guo, Zheng; Gao, Renjun
one_liner_zh: 该文通过共识设计和虚拟筛选结合分子动力学模拟，工程化改造GH42 β-半乳糖苷酶以提高乳糖水解活性，属于蛋白质结构计算辅助的酶工程研究，方法可迁移至蛋白质结构设计。
abstract: This study addresses a major bottleneck in dairy waste management by engineering a highly efficient, thermophilic enzyme for lactose hydrolysis, transforming the cheese manufacturing by-product whey into a high-value resource. While traditional glycoside hydrolase family 2 (GH2) enzymes suffer from poor industrial thermostability, thermophilic GH42 alternatives lack the catalytic efficiency required for practical processing. To bridge this gap, a synergistic engineering strategy combining consensus sequence design and virtual binding energy screening was applied to Tn1577, a home-discovered GH42-galactosidase from Thermotoga naphthophila RUK10. Through homologous sequence analysis and iterative saturation mutagenesis, a superior triple mutant designated M10 (H271Q/V357G/Q340E) was successfully developed. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations revealed that M10s performance is driven by 3 key structural alterations. First, a remodeled substrate tunnel accelerates lactose entry and product release while minimizing molecular congestion in the active cavity. Second, consensus mutations rigidify the catalytic pocket to preserve its geometry under thermal stress. Finally, a distal Q340E mutation rearranges local hydrogen bonding and forms a new anion-pi interaction, anchoring the protein backbone to stabilize the overall conformation via allosteric regulation. This engineered rigidity introduces a beneficial kinetic trade-off: it drastically accelerates catalytic turnover by intentionally weakening substrate affinity, preventing enzyme stagnation and ensuring continuous catalytic cycling. Consequently, mutant M10 achieves a remarkable 6.5-fold increase in lactose hydrolysis activity at 55 degrees C compared with the wild-type enzyme. Response surface methodology established ideal industrial parameters: 52.7 degrees C, pH 5.5, and an enzyme dosage of 2.9 U/mL. Under these conditions, M10 accomplishes near-complete lactose hydrolysis of raw whey within a brief 2-h window. Operating at a temperature below the thermal unfolding point of core whey proteins ( approximately 60 degrees C), this mild thermal regimen shortens processing times and prevents the thermal denaturation of other valuable whey components, demonstrating M10s immense potential for high-efficiency, stable lactose-free dairy processing.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过工程化一种高效嗜热酶用于乳糖水解，将奶酪生产副产物乳清转化为高价值资源，从而解决了乳制品废弃物管理中的主要瓶颈。传统糖苷水解酶家族2 (GH2) 酶工业热稳定性差，而嗜热GH42替代酶则缺乏实际加工所需的催化效率。为弥补这一差距，本研究对从Thermotoga naphthophila RUK10中自主发现的GH42-半乳糖苷酶Tn1577，采用了结合共有序列设计与虚拟结合能筛选的协同工程策略。通过同源序列分析和迭代饱和突变，成功开发出命名为M10 (H271Q/V357G/Q340E) 的优越三重突变体。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟揭示，M10的性能由3个关键结构改变驱动。首先，重塑的底物通道加速了乳糖进入和产物释放，同时减少了活性腔内的分子拥挤。其次，共有突变使催化口袋刚性化，以在热应力下保持其几何结构。最后，远端的Q340E突变重新排列了局部氢键，并形成新的阴离子-π相互作用，通过别构调节锚定蛋白质骨架以稳定整体构象。这种工程化的刚性引入了一种有益的动力学权衡：通过有意削弱底物亲和力，大幅加速催化周转，防止酶停滞并确保持续的催化循环。因此，与野生型酶相比，突变体M10在55摄氏度下乳糖水解活性提高了6.5倍。响应面法确定了理想的工业参数：52.7摄氏度、pH 5.5、酶用量2.9 U/mL。在此条件下，M10在短短2小时内即可实现原料乳清的近完全乳糖水解。在低于核心乳清蛋白热解折叠温度（约60摄氏度）的条件下运行，这种温和的热处理方案缩短了加工时间，并防止了其他有价值乳清成分的热变性，展示了M10在高效率、稳定的无乳糖乳制品加工中的巨大潜力。
